heading: CELTA — Cambridge Certificate in English Language Teaching to Adults
reqs-text: Min 120 hours over 4 weeks: input, tutorials, supervised lesson planning, 6 hours assessed teaching practice, peer observation, 6 hours directed observation, plus min 80 hours unsupervised work.
step1: Email celta@ihjoburg.co.za for the application form
step2: Application evaluated — interview at the school
step4: Deposit secures place — full payment 3 weeks before start
desc-text: Introductory teacher training for candidates with little or no previous TEFL experience. Recognised by EFL organisations worldwide — the most highly respected certificate of its kind.
intro: Full-time initial qualification, typically 4 weeks, awarded by the University of Cambridge. For candidates with little or no teaching experience.
profile-text: Awareness of language and competence in written and spoken English; education standard allowing entry to Higher Education; usually 20+ years old.
assess-text: Awarded on meeting criteria for all written and practical assignments: needs assessment, lesson planning, language knowledge, teaching skills, professional awareness.
practice-text:
Daily practice in groups of six; teach at least two different levels; verbal and written tutor feedback on each assessed lesson.

Candidates will be required to have a strong understanding of Google Drive & Google Docs and the ability to edit and upload documents to a shared folder.  We recommend you familiarise yourself with this before starting the course.
